[*] Fixed book descriptions
[*] With the increase in the level, the capacity of the hangar at the R&D Garage and the Flight Center is now correctly increasing
[*] Optimized the opening of the guild window
[*] Fixed occasional crash on character change
[*] Improved client stability
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.61 - Chasing snowflakes
notes.content:
Captains!

We hope the cold winds aren't throwing you off your course! There's less than a month left until the New Year, which means the holiday hunt for Snowflakes and Snowmen is open! You'll be able to find these resources almost everywhere — and it's worth doing it now, because this phenomenon is temporary. And now, let's look at the changelog:
[list]
[*] Added Snowflakes and Snowmen
[*] Added additional hints for beginners
[*] Added hints about books lying on the ground
[*] Craftsmanship effect now also affects resources obtained using the Steam Booster and the Delicacy Regulator
[*] It's now possible to upgrade the Prospector

[*] Added the ability to mass-start the production of concentrates
[*] Added the ability to install Bee Throwers in the "Forwarder" mk10
[*] Assembly time of strekolets now correctly decreases with increasing the R&D Garage's level
[*] Minor UI bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Back in business! - Update 7.57
notes.content:
Captains!

Many of you probably saw our previous announcement, where we talked about the problems we were experiencing at the time. We are happy to announce that the situation has been resolved, and we have no plans to stop working on the game for any reason at the moment. Thank you for staying with us!

Now, let's take a look at the changelog of today's update:

[list]
[*] Fixed cases where the "Property" tab did not work correctly when displaying a large list (for example, for large guilds)
[*] Fixed camera behavior when flying close to the ground
[*] Added the ability to upgrade the wall in the Sawmill after the 9th level
[*] Fixed issues in the Chinese localization
[*] Settlement buildings that have been destroyed by deterioration are no longer immediately removed, and can be repaired
[*] Buildings no longer deteriorate when the settlement is under the protection of the Inside Out
[*] In case the reward is sufficient and the weight is suitable, game characters can also take on your transportation job now.
[/list]

We would also like to point out that we are aware of a bug that may cause buildings in the settlement to be destroyed incorrectly and are working on pinpointing and fixing it.

See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: "Royal Vulture" update
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.56 has just been uploaded to the game server. We know it was a long wait and hope that you will enjoy all the new features! Full changelog is as follows:

• The pet "Royal Vulture" has been added - a magestic and proud creature that will follow you anywhere and assist you in combat, while also showing everyone your status.
• During extraction, 7 times fewer resources are burned now — thus, the total volume of extraction has been significantly increased.
• Added the ability to train settlement Managers and specialize them.
• The number of task slots for the guest in the settlement is now proportional to the levels of both the guest and owner characters — i.e. for the most effective use of someone else's settlement, the guest character must also be of a high level. This change will not affect the interaction with your own settlement in any way.
• Added playing cards.
• Saving gunners increases the character's reputation in their race.
• When a new character enters the game for the first time, two options are now available: to arrive with adventures on Sorcharon or to appear in the city right away.
• Tutorial progress is now reset only 10 minutes after the character exits the game — if you reconnect during this period, training will continue from where it left off.
• Fixed situations when a "Character unavailable" notification appeared when trying to connect to the game.
• The skill "Wolf 100" now requires 1 level of the skill "Production of warships"
• The skill "Paladin" now requires 2 levels of the skill "Production of warships"
• Improved stability.
• Some interface improvements.

See you in the air!

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Update 7.55
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.55 has just been uploaded to the game server. The changes aren't many, but they are very important!

Notable adjustments have been made to in-game payments: the cost of Clover in real currency has been reduced several times. You can view the new price on the purchase screen.

Players who made purchases before the release of update 7.55, will be compensated. The compensation will be calculated as follows:
[list]
[*] All the Clover purchased by a player starting from January 4, 2024, is summed up;
[*] The current balance of Clover on their account is added to this amount;
[*] The resulting amount is multiplied by 10 — the approximate ratio of the old Clover value to the new one;
[*] The new balance of Clover on the account is equal to this result.
[/list]

In other words, these players will receive all the Clover they've ever bought a second time, adjusted for its new price.

Apart from that, several fixes were made, aimed at improving client stability.

~LUCKCATCHERS2 Team

notes.title: Update 7.52
notes.content:
Captains!

Update 7.52 has just been uploaded to the server, and has brought some interesting stuff with it!

Now, you can paint your airship as you see fit - time to get creative!

Adopting a uniform color for your whole guild to boost the comradeship - easy!
Capturing a Bastion while piloting some very red, and thus very fast, ship - piece of cake!
Making your cargo transporting day brighter by doing it aboard your most astonishing vessel - yes please!

And that's just a couple of examples of how you can use this new feature. We're sure you'll enjoy it - so go ahead, pick the closest town to you and visit the Docking Port there!

But that's not all of the novelties. New entities have also been added to the game:
• Special protection crystals - they function much like the already existing ones, but can absorb much more damage. Each one of those has unique stats - and some may really surprise you with their capabilities!
• Guardians' protection crystals - another latest addition. These crystals can be recharged by spending mana!

And we should probably give you a little hint on how to find these wonders. We heard that one should take a closer look at the Inside Out.

That's it from us, and the rest is up to you to try out! See you in the air!
